files_modified.reason: Modify extractRawHeaderImports to use new BNF parser instead of placeholder regex logic.
Introduce new HeaderFact interface and update RawHeaderImportFact to reflect structured parsing. Add HeaderFact to PipelineState.
Update ElementData interface to potentially include structured HeaderFact and ensure headerStatus field is correctly handled.

files_created.purpose: New file to house the core semantic header parsing logic based on BNF grammar.
New file defining the HeaderFact interface and related types.

risks.description: Parser might not correctly interpret all valid header variations as per BNF, leading to 'partial' status for correctly formed headers.
risks.mitigation: Thorough unit testing with a wide range of valid and invalid header examples, including edge cases and diverse comment styles (e.g., Python docstrings, Go line comments).

risks.description: Performance impact of parsing every file's header, especially if the parsing logic is complex or regex-heavy.
risks.mitigation: Optimize parsing logic for efficiency; consider caching parsed headers for unchanged files. Leverage existing AST where possible to locate comment blocks efficiently.

risks.description: Drift between STANDARDS/layers.json and actual layer usage not being detected or handled gracefully.
risks.mitigation: Ensure robust runtime validation against loaded layers.json. Implement clear error reporting for invalid layer values.

risks.description: Incorrect cross-checking of @exports against AST exports, leading to false positives/negatives for 'stale' headerStatus.
risks.mitigation: Develop comprehensive test cases that cover various export scenarios (named, default, re-exports) and compare parser output with AST-derived exports accurately.

decision_records.decision: No changes to the canonical BNF grammar or STANDARDS/layers.json.
decision_records.rationale: The brief explicitly states these are canonical and not to be modified. Any ambiguities found will be documented for the orchestrator.

decision_records.decision: Prioritize robust error reporting for malformed headers.
decision_records.rationale: The brief specifies 'partial' status with a 'structured parse-error record'. This indicates a need for detailed feedback on parsing failures.
alternatives_considered: Silent failure or generic 'partial' status (rejected due to lack of diagnostic information)

error_states.description: Header present, all required tags valid, @exports matches AST exports.
Header present but @exports lists symbols not in the AST.
Header present but malformed (parse error in one or more tags); structured parse-error record attached.
No header block in the file at all.

cross_checks: Validate @layer against the 13 canonical values in STANDARDS/layers.json at runtime.
Validate @constraint items are kebab-case within the JSON array.
Validate @generated is a valid ISO 8601 timestamp.

test_planning_notes: The /plan-tests-for-workorder skill should focus on: comprehensive unit tests for the BNF parser covering all tag types and their validation rules (especially @layer, @exports, @imports, @generated); integration tests to ensure correct headerStatus transitions for 'missing', 'partial', 'stale', and 'defined' cases; tests for the replacement of RawHeaderImportFact placeholder logic with structured parsing; and performance tests for the parsing overhead.
